welcome.title: Welcome to {appName}
welcome.body:
{appName} is a free workspace for **game design documents**.

:::callout idea
Type `/` anywhere to insert headings, to-dos, toggles, callouts, tables and more.
:::

## Try it

- [ ] Write your game's one-sentence pitch
- [ ] List three design pillars
- [ ] Describe the core loop

:::toggle Where is my work stored?
In local mode everything stays in this browser (IndexedDB). Later you can connect a GitHub repository so your team can work on the same GDD.
:::
